title: Introducing OpenAI Frontier
summary: OpenAI Frontier is an enterprise platform for building, deploying, and managing AI agents with shared context, onboarding, permissions, and governance.
body: OpenAI Frontier is an enterprise platform for building, deploying, and managing AI agents with shared context, onboarding, permissions, and governance.
summaryZh: OpenAI Frontier是一个面向企业级市场的综合平台，专门用于构建、部署和管理AI Agent。该平台整合了共享上下文、用户引导、权限控制和治理框架，帮助企业更安全、高效地在大规模环境中落地和调度复杂的人工智能代理应用。
